clips.title: Promise call: agent's offer
clips.reference: Anna naa peru Ramesh, Kodimial nundi. Agent Raju Dubai lo driver job undi ani cheppadu, jeetham 1500 dirhams, rojuki 8 gantalu. Fee oka laksha kadu kadu oka laksha yaabhai velu adigadu, work visa ani cheppadu. Kafeel peru Saleem Al Harbi. Agent number tommidi enimidi nalugu enimidi double sunna aidu rendu moodu okati.

clips.title: Departure: visa is a visit visa
clips.reference: Anna flight repu Shamshabad nundi. Visa chusanu, visit visa ani raasi undi. Agent emo work visa tarvata vastundi annadu.

clips.title: Arrival: wrong person, passport taken
clips.reference: Anna Riyadh airport ki vachanu. Kafeel raaledu, vere okaru vachadu, atani peru Fahad. Passport teeskunnaru, iqama tarvata istham annaru.

clips.title: Week 2: goats, no salary, long hours
clips.reference: Anna ikkada edari lo mekalu kaayistunna, driver pani ledu. Rendu nelalu jeetham ivvaledu, arbab bukra bukra antunnadu. Rojuki padaharu gantalu pani.

clips.title: Distress call
clips.reference: Anna kodutunnaru, annam pettatledu, kapadandi. Kafeel huroob pettadu ani bediristhunnadu.

clips.title: Held-out: Hindi-English, visit visa, fee
clips.reference: Sir mera naam Imtiaz hai, Nizamabad se. Sub agent ko dedh lakh rupaye diye, visit visa pe bheja. Salary 1000 riyals bola tha lekin abhi 600 riyals de raha hai. Mera number nine seven zero one triple two five six eight.
